probe_contract: Create fresh SQLite DB and table.
Open one long-lived observer connection and one second writer connection.
Run separately with DELETE and WAL journal modes.
Record observer PRAGMA main.data_version and PRAGMA main.schema_version plus main-file st_dev/st_ino.
Commit DML on observer connection and test that observer data_version remains stable.
Commit DML on second connection and test that observer data_version changes while main-file device/inode stays equal.
Commit DDL on second connection and test that observer data_version and schema_version change while device/inode stays equal.
Repeat data_version without writes as no-change control.

interpretation.supported: On this isolated Python/SQLite runtime, PRAGMA main.data_version on a long-lived observer connection detects committed DML/DDL by another connection in both rollback-journal and WAL modes even though the main database st_dev/st_ino is unchanged.
interpretation.negative_control: Same-connection DML does not change that connection's PRAGMA data_version, matching SQLite documentation.
interpretation.schema_classifier: External DDL changed schema_version in both tested modes.
interpretation.evidence_boundary: This reproduces mechanism semantics only. It is not F2 code execution, not repository CI, not VPS/target runtime, not physical GRID10/GWT/J-Space evidence, and not whole-system acceptance.
